title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Heparin Unit Rate on Observation and Emergency Accounts
content:
**Payer agreement term.** Heparin (code J1644 under revenue code 0636) on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), carries a rate per counted unit of 3.20 USD on a Commercial HMO Claim, 3.60 USD on a Commercial PPO Claim, and otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) its charges per counted unit times the expected allowed percentage. It is valued at its counted units times that rate, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Basis question (hypothetical): *10 units on a Commercial HMO Claim, charges 75.00?* 32.00.
